title: eugenia malaccensis f. cericarpa
intro: Eugenia malaccensis f. cericarpa, commonly known as Ceriaca, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia malaccensis f. cericarpa are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-ulcerogenic, and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
